title: How Much Can Tool Calls Reveal About You? Privacy Leakage from Tool-Call Traces
abstract: arXiv:2610.41885v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents interact with external tools through protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), producing tool-call traces that may expose behavioral signals about users. In this work, we systematically study the risk of user-profile inference from MCP tool-call traces, where observers infer user attributes from protocol-valid tool interactions without access to user conversations. We introduce PrivacyTrace, a benchmark containing 1,000 synthetic user profiles and 4,000 agent trajectories across four domains, generated with real MCP tools from 25 servers. Experiments with four mainstream LLM attackers show that tool-call traces enable a 26.25% attack success rate for profile inference, compared with 17.97% from prior-based guessing. Further analysis reveals that tool arguments and returned results provide the main trace-grounded evidence, while linking traces across sessions further amplifies profiling

translated_title: 工具调用能暴露多少关于你的信息？来自工具调用轨迹的隐私泄露
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过模型上下文协议（MCP）等协议与外部工具交互，产生可能暴露用户行为信号的工具调用轨迹。在本工作中，我们系统研究了从MCP工具调用轨迹推断用户画像的风险，即观察者在无法访问用户对话的情况下，从符合协议的工具交互中推断用户属性。我们提出了PrivacyTrace，一个包含1,000个合成用户画像和4,000条覆盖四个领域的智能体轨迹的基准数据集，这些轨迹使用来自25个服务器的真实MCP工具生成。使用四种主流LLM攻击者的实验表明，工具调用轨迹可实现26.25%的用户画像推断攻击成功率，而基于先验知识的猜测成功率仅为17.97%。进一步分析揭示，工具参数和返回结果提供了主要的基于轨迹的证据，而跨会话关联轨迹会进一步放大用户画像的效果。
tldr: 该论文首次系统研究了从MCP工具调用轨迹推断用户隐私画像的风险，构建了包含1,000个用户画像和4,000条智能体轨迹的PrivacyTrace基准，发现LLM攻击者能以26.25%的成功率从工具调用轨迹推断用户属性，其中工具参数、返回结果及跨会话轨迹关联是主要的隐私泄露途径。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies the risk of user-profile inference from MCP tool-call traces, introduces the PrivacyTrace benchmark with 1,000 user profiles and 4,000 agent trajectories, and shows that LLM attackers can infer user attributes with a 26.25% success rate, with tool arguments, returned results, and cross-session trace linking being the main privacy leakage channels.
